v1_status: preserved negative result; never overwritten or reinterpreted
v2_status: preserved negative result; v2 reward direction was supported by the controllability audit but concat PPO did not learn preference-to-action control
scope: representation-only mechanism test; no formal test is authorized before the validation gate passes

controllability_audit.conclusion: fixed-state reward directions were correct; frozen concat PPO failed the preference-to-action mapping

fixed_v2_mechanics.delayed_estimate_quality: actual remote process observable age/covariance proxy, unchanged
fixed_v2_mechanics.runtime_executor: plan_controlled_feedback remains the only side-effect entry

conditioning.strict_concat_baseline: the three frozen v2 concat checkpoints; no retraining or selection
conditioning.v3_model: state 104-d observation feeds a [128,128] state trunk; preference 5-simplex feeds an 8-unit encoder; FiLM scale-and-shift modulates both hidden layers
conditioning.parameter_control: same [128,128] state trunk and actor/critic heads as v2; only a small 5->8 preference encoder and two 8->(2*hidden) FiLM projections are added
conditioning.concat_input_layout: 104 observable-state values followed by the frozen five-dimensional preference

preference_sampling: per training episode: deterministic pseudorandom uniform draw from the frozen set using training_seed*100003+episode_index; every listed point has equal mass
checkpoint_selection: unchanged deterministic validation: conservation gate -> max validation mean_return -> lower mean cost -> earlier update

mechanism_gate.scope: three v3 FiLM training seeds on validation and the frozen controllability-audit states
requirements: on stale_local_fresh_remote, estimate_quality share/process masked probability is greater than communication_saving for every seed
on stale_local_fresh_remote, communication_saving share probability is lower than estimate_quality for every seed
on resource_pressure, resource_saving sample probability is lower than completion for every seed
on sample_legal, completion service-action probability (sample+process+share) is greater than resource_saving for every seed
every seed has a nonzero raw-logit finite-difference L1 response between estimate_quality and communication_saving in the remote-information state
validation action and communication summaries are reported but cannot substitute for the fixed-state tests
mechanism_gate.on_failure: retain v3 as a negative result; do not tune reward, select seeds, expand the network, or release/read test-v5

test_v5_dependency: config/preference_ppo_v3_splits.json remains sealed; test-v5 is inaccessible to this stage and all older test partitions are historical only
